description: DeepSight eyes regression manifest. Golden = user-validated ground truth; synthetic = deterministic; public = Wikimedia Commons, title-anchored (see eval/images/public/.sources.json). Expected fields are anchored to current eyes behavior so regressions fail loudly; known weaknesses are documented in 'note'.

images.note: 1980 Philadelphia four-sport group photo (Erving/McGraw/Jaworski/Peeters). OCR reads SIXERS jersey; sports signals from grid-upscaled crops.
SGA mid-action on hardwood, OKC Thunder jersey. Upscaled OCR reads THUNDE. scene_top1 varies between runs (basketball vs ballgames) — expect the stable ballgames label top-3.
UNISTELLAR smart-telescope brand photo. KNOWN WEAKNESS: hat -> baseball false positive (0.80) is anchored on purpose; fixing it is a future change that must update this entry.
Blue-toned abstract/jellyfish art. Weak scene confidences (0.08) are the honest ceiling; assert the signals that are real.
